title: Chapter 323 Smoked
content:
Chapter 323 Smoked

But Zhong Yu thought about it, considering that his injuries were indeed serious, and his strength was seriously weakened.

If you really fight with the wine-swallowing boy, you really don't have much confidence.

If these four warriors join, then the odds of winning will definitely increase greatly. As for killing this alcohol-swallowing boy, it was easy to catch, and he was sure of winning.

After all, it is related to his first battle to become famous in the entire Yamamoto County, and even Dewa Country, so it is right to be cautious.

Otherwise, if you really capsize in the gutter, if you lose this battle, it will be extremely detrimental to your reputation in the future.

The next day, when the sun was rising and the light was shining on the land again, Zhong Yu and his party walked towards the dense forest that they feared like tigers and leopards in the distance under the strange eyes of the surrounding villagers.

This time, among the four warriors who followed Zhong Yu, two grew up locally, so they were quite familiar with the terrain of the dense forest.

Even more familiar than ordinary hunters, because hunters are not strong enough to dare to go deep into the dense forest.

But they are warriors. Not to mention their strength, they are also natives of the local area. They also know how to avoid some poisonous snakes and beasts, so they can go deeper into the dense forest.

Under the guidance of these two warriors, Zhong Yu and his party quickly circled in the dense forest, walked three or four miles, and went deep into the center of the dense forest.

Finally, the skill stopped outside the entrance of a stone cave in the center of the dense forest.

Looking from the outside to the inside of the cave, it is dark and the sky cannot be seen. Another gust of wind blew out, biting cold. The whistling sound of Yinfeng was extremely strange, and people could tell at a glance that this cave was not a good place to go.

"My lord, in front of you is the cave where the wine-swallowing boy is. For so many years, the wine-swallowing boy has been entrenched here, and he has never moved his lair at all."

Zhong Yu nodded upon hearing the warrior's prompt, and fixed his eyes on the inside of the cave.

Shuten Doji?

Zhong Yu couldn't help thinking about the origin of Shuten-douji in his mind.

It is said that Jiu Tun Boy was a child who was greedy for alcohol. After getting drunk, he fell into the wine vat brewed by an adult, and was drowned by the wine in the end.

After death, the ghost lingered, and then attached to the corpse, and finally formed the Shuten-douji.

Because he was a child when he died, Tun Tong was not very mentally sound, and he loved playing with his peers very much.

But after all, he is a ghost, so how could he be accepted by children of the same age? Often when I saw him, I would be terrified, crying and looking for my parents.

Under the long-term discriminatory treatment, Shuten Douzi's mind was gradually distorted, and finally developed to like to eat those children, in order to retaliate against them for not playing with him.

The Shuten-douji in front of him was roughly formed in this way.

However, according to his formation to the present, it is estimated that it has been more than 30 years, among which he has eaten more than 300 children. Over time, his strength has become extremely terrifying.

Even if the cultivation speed of demons and ghosts is far behind that of human beings, their accumulation can at least push their own cultivation to the second level.

Therefore, Shuten-douji is very likely to be a second-level master, and he has cultivated a whole body of monster power, which is very terrifying.

However, although Jiu Tun-douji is terrifying, Zhong Yu himself is not down.

Not only has his cultivation recovered to the second level, but his own realm is still there. With the eyesight of the sixth level, it really shouldn't be too easy to deal with a mere second level.

so……

"Jiu Tun-dou, the evil spirit said, now that my lord is coming to attack you, why don't you wash your neck quickly and surrender with your head."

Zhong Yu yelled violently, and yelled directly into the cave.

However, there was no sound coming from inside the cave, and it was still peaceful for a long time.

Zhong Yu's complexion was a little ugly, and Tun Doji dared to ignore him like this. This was not only a provocation to his majesty, but also represented that Jiu Tun Doji's wisdom had grown to a certain level.

Because a child, no matter how outstanding his resourcefulness is, is still lacking in character and easily provoked by others.

Not to mention Jiu Tun-douji, who like to drink too much, are usually careless and irritable, and their temperament is not very stable.

Now it refuses to come out, presumably because it knows that since outsiders dare to attack him, they must have certain strength, so it plans to hide in the cave and observe secretly.

By the way, he planned to introduce outsiders into the cave and carry out a sneak attack in his own field. With this kind of resourcefulness, it can no longer be regarded as the wisdom of a child.

It seems that after more than 30 years of growth, his mind has gradually become closer to that of an adult.

In this case, it would be impossible for him to enrage Shuten-douji and lead him out of the cave to fight on the plain at the entrance of the cave, just like how he dealt with children before.

In this case, we must think of a strategy to draw him out.

Otherwise, if you really follow Shuten-douji's path into the cave, who knows what kind of mechanism is dangerous in the cave, or even a tunnel branch to separate them, it will be an extremely dangerous thing.

"My lord, this Shuten-douji refuses to come out, what should we do? Should we go into the cave to attack?"

At this time, a warrior next to Zhong Yu asked, with worried eyes, obviously afraid that Zhong Yu really wanted to do this.

"No, it's too dangerous to go into the cave to fight. It's like falling into Shuten-douji's trap. You can't do this."

Zhong Yu turned his eyes to a samurai who asked, shook his head, and refused.

"Then how should we let Shuten-doji come out? Under the threat, it seems that he will only hide in the cave, and it is impossible for him to come out. Should we just flee back to the village in desperation?"

Another samurai beside him questioned, his tone a bit sharp.

He originally disapproved of this crusade. He was not born in this small mountain village, and it was impossible for him to understand how deeply the villagers who grew up in this mountain village hated the boy who swallowed wine.

"The cave where Shuten Doji is located is only in a small hill, which is not high, more than 30 meters, and covers a small area.

Judging from the dark wind blowing from the cave just now, this cave should have some other ventilation holes besides the opening of the cave.

We just need to find that vent hole, then block it, put smoke in this hole, and blow the smoke in. Kaoru could also smoke this Jiu Tun Doji to death. I'm not afraid that he won't come out by then. "

Zhong Yu thought for a while, and said the strategy he came up with just now through observing the form.

"As expected of an adult, he comes from a noble background. He came up with this strategy in such a short period of time. He really is extraordinary."

The two warriors from the mountain village next to him, after hearing Zhong Yu's words, quickly flattered them.

They are different from the other two samurai from other places, and their hatred for Shuten-douji is not weaker than that of the villagers.

Even because of being a samurai, he has greater force than the villagers. But he failed to protect the villagers, and instead had to compromise with these monsters.

He hated Shuten-douji even more, thinking that he had deeply hurt their dignity as a samurai.
